acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with load and counts; confirm or refute the timeout cause; fixed tests pass at load ~50 without widening the product bound (or the test asserts the documented refusal); one mutation proving the fix.
body: Observed 2026-10-15 by the V1-1411 lane (PR #923, BASE 778bfcd3d), no CPU burners. TestProductionParentBindsNonASCIIRepositoryPath (main_test.go:699) and TestExecuteNormalCompletionHasNoRecordedSurvivors (qualification_lifecycle_test.go:76) fail with 'go-live provider: execution authority changed: post-run revalidation'. BASE: pass at load 34-40, fail at load 49-59; HEAD (unrelated change): 3 failures at load 35-52. Suspected (inferred): the 15s postAuthorityTimeout in internal/liveverify/provider/provider.go:43 expires under load. Repro: GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -run 'TestProductionParentBindsNonASCIIRepositoryPath|TestExecuteNormalCompletionHasNoRecordedSurvivors' ./cmd/corvint-go-test-provider/ at load ~50. Likely to fail full-gate on this host.
title: cmd/corvint-go-test-provider tests fail under host load: execution authority changed: post-run revalidation
